comment: Classification of failure signatures into: bug (component violates its own contract), design (correctly implemented behavior whose cost/failure follows from a design choice), policy (guard working as intended; not a failure), external (remote service fault), unknown. Rules are matched in order against lowercased (tool, signature); first match wins. Deterministic and reviewable — judgment lives here, not in prose.
